metadata.title: SpaceX-xAI (Super Intelligence) Compute Fleet, BTM Power & Aerospace Atlas
metadata.author: Marvin (Oakcliff Capital)

properties.name: Colossus 1 (Flagship Supercomputer — 3231 Paul R. Lowry Rd)
properties.mw_label: ~300 MW nameplate (~150 MW Ph. 1 built in 122 days; ~100k H100 + GB200s; 1,200 MW long-term master plan)
properties.power_type: 150 MW MLGW/TVA substation (2nd 150 MW TVA-approved Feb. 2026, unenergized) + 15 permitted on-site CTC gas turbines + 150 MW Tesla Megapacks
properties.water_cooling: Direct evaporative cooling (~0.8 MGD early actual up to 3.0 MGD design draw from Memphis Sands aquifer; $80M T.E. Maxson greywater plant planned)
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational since Sept. 2024. SCHD Air Permit No. 01156-01PC (15 permanent turbines) upheld 6-1 Dec. 15, 2025; no PILOT tax break (> $30M/yr taxes). Rented to Anthropic under May 2026 CSA.
properties.confidence: HIGH (SpaceX Form 424B4, Q3 2026 10-Q & SCHD Permit) / MEDIUM (Compute Atlas)

properties.name: Colossus 2 (Whitehaven Campus — 5400/5420 Tulane Rd)
properties.mw_label: ~800–1,000 MW active at Q3 2026 (~110k GB200 Cluster 1 [210 MW in 91 days] + ~440k GB300 Cluster 2+ [~740+ MW])
properties.power_type: Cross-border BTM gas lines from Southaven Stanton Rd Power Station + 5.9 GWh Tesla Megapack BESS + 260 MW MLGW study
properties.water_cooling: Hybrid cooling (~130 dry coolers + ~135 adiabatic units; ~267M gal/yr evaporation; $80M T.E. Maxson recycled wastewater plant)
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational & expanding (1M sq ft warehouse + 100 acres bought for $80M). Hosts Anthropic CSA, Google 110k GB300 CSA ($920M/mo), and Grok-5 training. W.D. Tenn. contractor dispute with Darana Hybrid ($500M+ claim vs. $569M liens, Q3 10-Q Note 16).
properties.confidence: HIGH (SpaceX Form 424B4 & Q3 2026 10-Q) / MEDIUM (SemiAnalysis & Epoch AI)

properties.name: MiniHard (Colossus 2 North — 5414 Tulane Rd)
properties.mw_label: 450 MW TVA grid service request (~220,000 GB300 GPUs; new 4-story, 312,000 sq ft building, $659M investment)
properties.power_type: TVA 450 MW grid service request via new 500 kV gas-insulated substation connecting to Freeport substation (due Dec. 31, 2026)
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction (~5-month build started March 2026). CRITICAL GATE: Energization depends on Dec. 31, 2026 completion of TVA 500 kV GIS substation.

properties.name: MACROHARDRR (xAI Southaven Bldg 1 — 2400 Stateline Rd W)
properties.mw_label: 700 MW TVA grid service request (810,000 sq ft former GXO warehouse retrofit; part of >$20B MS investment)
properties.power_type: TVA 700 MW grid service request (via Dec. 31, 2026 500 kV GIS substation) + <0.25 mi from Stanton Rd BTM gas plant
properties.water_cooling: High-density liquid cooling with planned municipal water recycling
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction (announced Dec. 30, 2025 / Jan. 8, 2026 by Gov. Tate Reeves; approved for MS Data Center sales-tax exemption & DeSoto County fee-in-lieu). Gated by Dec. 31, 2026 TVA 500 kV substation.
properties.confidence: HIGH (MS Governor Release Jan. 8, 2026 & Form 424B4) / MEDIUM (SemiAnalysis 700 MW TVA request)

properties.name: Project SPAM (Colossus 2 Center Infill Hall)
properties.mw_label: ~250–400 MW est. (started Oct. 5, 2026; first tranches targeted Dec. 2026 in <90 days)
properties.power_type: Shared Colossus 2 / Southaven BTM gas + 5.9 GWh Tesla Megapack BESS + Dec. 31, 2026 TVA 500 kV substation
properties.water_cooling: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling + hybrid dry/adiabatic rejection (PUE 1.10–1.15)
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction (broke ground Oct. 5, 2026 per SemiAnalysis). Part of the 2.5–3.0 GW YE2026 ramp; faces ~300 MW campus-wide power deficit once temporary Southaven turbines retire in July 2027.

properties.name: xAI Tulane Road Data Center (8325 Tulane Rd — 5th Memphis-Area Site)
properties.mw_label: ~300–400 MW est. (660,000 sq ft data center on former Southaven city training parcel)
properties.power_type: Adjacent to Stanton Rd gas-turbine plant + TVA grid
properties.permits_outstanding: Permitted (Southaven Board of Aldermen approved rezoning Sept. 2, 2026 after xAI land swap + $40M payment for new city facility; Alderman Hoots voted no over unfinished turbine noise barrier).
properties.confidence: MEDIUM (DeSoto Times-Tribune, Action News 5 & Compute Atlas)

properties.name: xAI Southaven 'Gun Range' Plot (6th Memphis-Area Site)
properties.mw_label: ~300–500 MW est. (~4-month rapid build target for Q1 2027)
properties.power_type: Southaven Stanton Rd BTM gas + TVA grid + Megapack BESS
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction. In Aug. 2026, MDEQ issued Notices of Violation to MZX Tech for land-disturbing construction prior to Large Construction Stormwater General Permit coverage across 3 MS sites ($6.1M penalty exposure, Q3 10-Q Part II Item 1).
properties.confidence: HIGH (Q3 2026 10-Q Item 1 Stormwater NOV) / MEDIUM (SemiAnalysis Nov. 4, 2026)

properties.name: Starbase AI Data Centers (2 Gigawatt-Scale Halls — Boca Chica)
properties.mw_label: >1,000 MW planned for 2027 (2 data center halls; ground cleared Aug. 2026, steel vertical Sep. 2026; Vera Rubin NVL72)
properties.power_type: 100% Behind-the-Meter mobile gas turbines (arrived Oct. 2026; relocating retired Southaven turbines) + 2 natural gas pipelines under construction
properties.water_cooling: Closed-loop liquid cooling + Gulf Coast air/adiabatic rejection; fiber channel via Port of Brownsville
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction. HIGH POST-MIDTERM EXPOSURE: Relocating temporary Southaven gas turbines and operating permanent BTM gas in Texas faces Gov. Abbott's Sept. 21 TCEQ air-permit freeze and Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa's moratorium platform.
properties.confidence: MEDIUM (SemiAnalysis Nov. 4, 2026 satellite imagery & local filings)

properties.name: Terafab Gibbons Creek Chip Fab & Data Center Complex (Grimes Co.)
properties.mw_label: ~500–1,000 MW DC potential alongside $16.8B, 100M sq ft Terafab chip fab (targeting Q3/Q4 2028 volume fab)
properties.power_type: Retired 470 MW Gibbons Creek coal plant 345 kV ERCOT switchyard + planned multi-GW BTM gas & solar
properties.water_cooling: Gibbons Creek Reservoir industrial water supply + ultrapure water recycling
properties.permits_outstanding: Proposed / early site work (confirmed Aug. 6, 2026 by SpaceX & Gov. Abbott; Aug. 2026 Grimes County video showed compute halls & open 3P leasing). Gated by TX JETI compliance, TCEQ Sept. 21 air-permit freeze, ERCOT queue audit, and Gov.-elect Hinojosa.
properties.confidence: HIGH (Form 424B4, Q3 2026 Call & TX JETI filings) / MEDIUM (SemiAnalysis DC scope)

properties.name: Tesla Cortex 2.0 AI Training Cluster (Giga Texas — Potential Merger Asset)
properties.operator: Tesla, Inc. (SpaceX Special Committee Merger Evaluation)
properties.mw_label: 500 MW planned (~250 MW Ph. 1; Nvidia GPUs for FSD/Optimus; SpaceX & Tesla formed special committees Oct. 2026 to evaluate merger)
properties.power_type: Bluebonnet Electric Cooperative grid + 30 MW rooftop solar + Tesla Megapack BESS
properties.permits_outstanding: Under construction / ramping at Giga Texas. In Oct. 2026 (Q3 10-Q p. 38), SpaceX and Tesla formed independent special committees to evaluate a corporate combination.

properties.name: CTC Property BTM Gas Turbine Plant (Colossus 1 — 3231 Paul R. Lowry Rd)
properties.mw_label: 15 permanent gas turbines permitted (~180–240 MW est.; peaked at 35 turbines / 421.4 MW in Mar. 2025 before temp units removed)
properties.power_type: On-site natural gas simple-cycle aeroderivative turbines (Solar SMT-130/SMT-60, GE LM2500) with 2 ppm NOx SCR controls
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational under Shelby County Health Dept. Air Permit No. 01156-01PC (issued July 2, 2025). Memphis & Shelby Co. Air Pollution Control Board dismissed NAACP/SELC appeal 6-1 as moot on Dec. 15, 2025.

properties.name: Colossus 2 Power Station (MZX Tech / Solaris Stateline JV — 2875 Stanton Rd S)
properties.operator: MZX Tech LLC & Stateline Power LLC (50.1% Solaris / 49.9% xAI)
properties.mw_label: 1,200 MW permanent plant (41 turbines permitted Mar. 11, 2026) replacing 69 temp turbines (~2.4–2.7 GW peak; 58 running after 11 powered down Aug. 31)
properties.power_type: 41 permanent gas turbines (17 Solar Titan PGM-130 + 16 Solar Titan 350 + 8 ProEnergy 6000PE) + Solaris JV rental fleet
properties.permits_outstanding: MDEQ PSD Permit No. 0680-00119 issued Mar. 11, 2026 (24 tpy HAP cap). Under July 30, 2026 MDEQ agreement, all 69 temporary turbines must be removed by July 2027. LIVE LITIGATION: NAACP v. X.AI & MZX Tech (N.D. Miss. 3:26-cv-00074); on Oct. 19, 2026, 5th Cir. denied stay and District Court denied DOJ motion to dismiss.
properties.confidence: HIGH (Q3 2026 10-Q Note 16, Form 424B4 Note 9 & MDEQ Permit 0680-00119)

properties.name: Bastrop Starlink & Starmind AI1 Factory (+ Austin Research Fab)
properties.mw_label: ~150 MW industrial & R&D complex (doubling Bastrop factory in 2026; designated Starmind AI1 orbital server factory + Austin test fab)
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational (hosted Q2 & Q3 2026 earnings webcasts). Austin research fab targets first functional test SRAM chip in May/June 2027; Starmind AI1 (Vera Rubin NVL72, 250 kW) prototype launches targeted 2027.

properties.name: Hawthorne Falcon 9 & Turbine-Blade Investment Casting Complex
properties.mw_label: ~100 MW aerospace manufacturing & superalloy casting complex
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational. Houses SpaceX's Raptor rocket-engine superalloy investment-casting foundry, which Musk confirmed on the Q3 2026 call is now casting gas-turbine blades and vanes in-house to bypass 12–18 month supplier backlogs.

properties.name: Starbase Headquarters, Gigabays & Starship Orbital Launch Complex
properties.mw_label: ~120 MW spaceport, Gigabays, air-separation propellant plants & two orbital launch pads
properties.power_type: ERCOT grid + on-site gas/solar + air separation units
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational HQ. Completed Starship Flight 14 (first orbital flight deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites = 26 Tbps) in late Q3 2026; FAA license for Flight 15 dual booster+ship tower catch expected Nov. 2026.

properties.name: Redmond Starlink Satellite & Optical-Link Manufacturing Facility
properties.mw_label: ~80 MW satellite & optical transceiver manufacturing hub (>11,100 active satellites in orbit)
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational. Augmented by July 6, 2026 acquisition of Mesh Optical Technologies ($249M in Class A stock, Q3 10-Q Note 20) for high-speed data-center & inter-satellite optical transceivers.

properties.name: Cape Canaveral & Kennedy Space Center Launch Complex (LC-39A, SLC-40, SLC-37)
properties.mw_label: ~90 MW East Coast launch complex (LC-39A, SLC-40, HangarX/X2 refurbishment, and Starship SLC-37 under construction)
properties.permits_outstanding: Operational for Falcon 9 / Falcon Heavy; building Starship launch towers at LC-39A and SLC-37 to support high-cadence V3 and Starmind launches.

properties.name: Starbase Louisiana Next-Generation Megaport (20+ Starship Launch Towers)
properties.mw_label: ~250 MW planned spaceport & cryogenic propellant complex (designed for 20+ launch towers & millions of tonnes/yr to orbit)
properties.power_type: Entergy Louisiana grid + on-site natural gas cryogenic air separation
properties.permits_outstanding: Announced in Q3 2026 Earnings Release (Oct. 20, 2026): first Starship launch targeted for 2028–2029. Required to achieve the thousands of annual Starship flights needed for 10–100 GW of orbital compute.
properties.confidence: HIGH (SpaceX Q3 2026 Earnings Release Ex. 99.1 & Q3 Call)
